notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as marked '(starting)' in the list: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Prepared Defenses, Visage Of The Emperor, and the Effects First Strike, Secret Plans, You Cannot Hide Forever and Imperial Decree; they count toward the 60. The strategy explains that Secret Plans and First Strike always start and the third Effect is You Cannot Hide Forever or Imperial Decree depending on the opponent, so no single starting effect is set.
Posted 'Bossk In Mist Hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (the only Mist Hunter card; Bossk In Hound's Tooth is listed separately).
Posted 'Emperor Palpitine', 'Aura Sing', 'Devestator', 'Jabba's Palace Audence Chamber', 'Prepared Defences' and 'Security Percautions' dested by spelling.
Dark pages dested for the dual-printed sites: Endor: Back Door (Dark), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark), Tatooine: Cantina (Dark).
Plain 'Darth Maul' dested the Tatooine-set Darth Maul; 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield). Total 60.
